body_html:
John Michaels | DJ, Sports Broadcaster, Hype Machine

Hailing from Miami, Florida, John Michaels brings the heat—both on the mic and behind the decks. A professional DJ since 2004, John’s love for music and passion for getting people moving launched a career that now spans high-energy club nights, unforgettable corporate parties, and electrifying sports watch events.

When he’s not rocking the turntables, you can catch John on the airwaves at 680 The Fan, Atlanta’s premier sports radio station, where he brings insider energy and sharp commentary to coverage of the Braves, Falcons, Hawks, Georgia Tech, and more. His background in sports broadcasting means he knows how to hype a crowd, read a room, and keep the energy flowing from the first beat to the last play.

In his headphones? It’s a mix of Rick Ross, Kendrick Lamar, Drake, and a splash of rock to keep things fresh and unpredictable. His sets are just as versatile—seamlessly blending hip-hop, pop, rock, and throwbacks to keep every crowd on their feet.

John is a proud husband and father of three, and in his downtime, he lives and breathes sports—coaching AAU basketball and staying active in the community. Whether it’s a downtown rooftop, a corporate celebration, or a jam-packed watch party, John brings a high-energy, professional approach with the music knowledge and charisma to match.

Get ready for a DJ who doesn’t just play music—he creates moments.
